name: Vocalizer Pro
author: Awenk Audico & Flowork OS
description: Sovereign Real-Time Vocal Processing Suite reverse-engineered from VST3. Features dynamic pitch tracking & autotune, 4-voice polyphonic harmonizer, 6-band parametric EQ, noise gate, de-esser, compressor, saturation, chorus/modulation, ducking delay, and studio reverb with interactive SVG 706x532 UI.
